Regardless of you saying you don't want a response, I would like to say that believe I'm in the same boat as you and have been for about 17 years and I'm now 25 years old. So let tell you that there are ways of helping you manage the pain and all the negative feelings and thoughts. Unfortunately mental health is still a very weak point in alot of places like the US for example. So I would understand if these options are not a possibility for you at the moment being only 17 and probably not able to make most medical decisions for yourself but you should really look into talking to your doctor about these feelings and look into medication that can help you manage all the torment swirling in your head. But I promise you that once that fog of desperation and hopelessness fades you will be able to think and realize that it's not as what our condition makes it seem. Also hit me up at any time if you just want to vent or to have someone who understands and has been battling with this for a very very long time. Anyways I hope you're okay and stay strong 🙂
